Furthermore, the direct collocation method assumes that the cost function and any path constraints can also be represented in terms of these discretized variables. questions.answer:

In other words, the control inputs are computed in advance based on the initial conditions and the system model, and they are applied as planned without adjustment based on subsequent observations of the system state.
